findings.description: No PNG visual evidence files exist. 8 of 13 requirements marked UNVERIFIED despite implementation in code. Install ImageMagick or Poppler and generate PNGs to complete visual verification.

Opening word window feature (requirement f) not implemented in either adapter. Bold emphasis works but empty space below opening words is missing. Vivliostyle needs shape-outside + JS measurement (150-250 LOC), Typst needs custom layout (100-200 LOC).
Vivliostyle baseline grid alignment between columns (requirement e) fails. Known limitation documented in issue #1157. Workaround requires custom CSS Grid or JavaScript layout (200-400 LOC).

Typst full-width footnotes (requirement h) fail. Footnotes appear per-column rather than full-width above both columns. Forum discussion confirms limitation. Manual footnote system required (300-500 LOC).
Typst last-line centering (requirement g) fails. No text-align-last equivalent. Custom paragraph show rule needed (150-300 LOC).
Both engines produce non-deterministic PDFs (requirement m) due to embedded timestamps. Byte-level comparison fails. Workaround: strip PDF metadata before hashing (50-100 LOC).
David font has limited teamim coverage. Requirement (b) marked PARTIAL. Install Ezra SIL (zero code changes) and regenerate PDFs to verify full teamim support.
